name: Daskinor, Sorcerer-King

alignment.name: Chaotic Evil
alignment.description:
Chaotic evil creatures have a complete disregard for others. They kill, steal, and betray others to gain power. Their word is meaningless and their actions destructive. Their worldviews can be so warped that they destroy anything and anyone that doesn’t directly contribute to their interests.
	By the standards of good and lawful good people, chaotic evil is as abhorrent as evil, perhaps even more so. Chaotic evil monsters such as demons and orcs are at least as much of a threat to civilization and general well-being as evil monsters are. An evil creature and a chaotic evil creature are both opposed to good, but they don’t have much respect for each other either and rarely cooperate toward common goals.
	For the purpose of game effects, a chaotic evil creature is also considered evil.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Stench of Paranoia
traits.details: Enemies are slowed while in the aura.

traits.name: Man of Two Minds
traits.details: On an initiative count of 10 + his initiative check, Daskinor takes a standard, a move, or a minor action of his choice as a free action. If Daskinor cannot use a free action as a result of a dazing or stunning effect, that effect ends immediately, instead of him taking the action.

auras.name: Stench of Paranoia
auras.details: Enemies are slowed while in the aura.

hit.description: psychic damage, and Daskinor pushes the target up to 3 squares.

miss.description: Half damage, and Daskinor can push the target 1 square.

effect.description: Each target must take a free action to charge or make a melee basic attack against the creature nearest to it. If an enemy and an ally are the same distance from the target, the target must attack the ally.

powers.name: Get Away from Me!
powers.requirements: Daskinor must have at least one enemy within 3 squares of him.

effect.description: Each enemy adjacent to Daskinor takes 20 psychic damage, and he teleports up to 6 squares.
Daskinor slides the target a number of squares up to its speed, and the target makes a melee basic attack as a free action against a target of Daskinor’s choice.

Daskinor creates a psionic manifestation of his evil twin, which appears in an unoccupied square within 5 squares of him and lasts until the end of the encounter. The evil twin appears to be Daskinor but is illusory and cannot be attacked. When Daskinor moves, he can move his evil twin an equal number of squares as a part of the same action. Daskinor can make ego whip and psychic repulsion attacks as though he occupies the square of his evil twin.

powers.name: Psionic Reflection
powers.trigger: Daskinor takes psychic damage from an attack.
